evidence.observation: Initial growth-stage temperature overshoot to 760.2 °C accompanies heater power reduction to 39.6%.
Temperature has settled to 750.4 °C against a 750.0 °C setpoint, with heater power 41.3%.
Argon flow is 99.9 sccm against 100.0 sccm setpoint; pressure 3.063 Torr and exhaust oxygen 4.3 ppm remain consistent with stable post-purge conditions.
